description: Session intent classifies who is driving a session and the requested engine posture. It does not grant launch, mutation, bounded-execution, save, or runtime authority.

authorityBoundary.rule: The active workflow, skill authority, process ownership, save-safety rules, and bounded-execution gates always override session intent.
authorityBoundary.humanProtection: human_player may never be upgraded into automation solely because another field requests an automated priority mode.

human_player.description: A human is playing normally. The requested posture is observe-only unless a separate active contract explicitly authorizes bounded work.

multitasking.description: The operator is using another window while the game remains live. Read-only observation may continue; any mutation still requires separate active authority.

agentBehaviorRules.parallel_sprint: Use isolated repository state and do not mutate the live game session without independent authority.

automation_script.description: A script or automation runner is driving. This requests normal automation posture but does not authorize execution by itself.

ai_agent.description: An AI agent is the declared driver. Automation is only a requested posture; active workflow and bounded-execution authority remain mandatory.

ci_cd.description: CI/CD is the declared driver. Aggressive proof collection is requested, but no runtime or mutation authority is implied.

unknown.description: Unknown driver. Conservative requested posture: all engines manual and observe-only.

priorityEngineModes.conserve_resources: Requested conservative posture for survival-critical routing only when separately authorized.
priorityEngineModes.observe_only: Read state only; no mutation authority.
priorityEngineModes.normal: Requested normal priority cascade with all existing safety and bounded-execution gates still required.
priorityEngineModes.aggressive_proof: Requested higher proof throughput; does not authorize gameplay mutation or weaken proof ceilings.

agentVisibilityRules.description: When a session-intent artifact exists, agents may use it as context, not authority.
rules: drivenBy identifies the declared session driver
sprint identifies the declared active sprint
priorityEngineMode is a requested posture only
branch/commitSha identify the code context being exercised
